scope: Conditional clock method and exact numerical budget design only, before importer/A/A implementation; no native qualification

approved_design.paired_metric_conversion_budget: at most 1/1000 relative deviation at each exact ratio endpoint
approved_design.short_or_zero_lower_endpoint_handling: entire paired metric INCONCLUSIVE, all original observations retained
approved_design.percentiles: nearest rank on all lower/upper endpoints separately
approved_design.runtime_branch_inference: conditional construction-based startup/provider/clock-mode/lifetime argument; not observation of internal variables
approved_design.controlled_lab_assumptions: declare no intervention and runner-denied pause/input/reset, retain available operation evidence, stop on observed violations; continuous exclusion unobserved
approved_design.historical_counter_metadata: retain original frequency-derived milliseconds and actual min/median/max aggregates; five raw anchors were not retained

remaining_requirements: Qualify actual per-host executable/provider/startup/lifetime/control context, freeze the exact conversion/ratio policy before A/A, review the importer/statistical endpoint use, and retain complete actual A/A/confirmation plus separate durability/structural evidence.
